Description:
Negates the **Inefficient Hooking** status and increases rating for caught fish.
Available only when fishing for cosmic exploration.
Shreds toxic weeds in a cone-shaped area before you.
Dash forward, shredding toxic weeds in your path.
Sprays a jet of flame in a cone before you, incinerating small toxic weeds. Has no effect on larger specimens.
Sprays growth formula in a cone before you, accelerating the sublimation cycle of mercorn.

Scatters growth formula in a wide radius around the mech, accelerating the sublimation cycle of mercorn.
Can only be executed while under the effect of **Formula Case**.

Sprays growth formula in a wide-angle cone before you, accelerating the sublimation cycle of dwarf mercorn. Has no effect on larger specimens.
Can only be executed while under the effect of **Supplementary Formula**.
Sprays growth formula in a cone before you, accelerating the sublimation cycle of dwarf mercorn. Has no effect on larger specimens.
Sprays growth formula, accelerating the growth of target flora.

Drive your shovel into the ground.
※Has no effect in battle.
